plain: In November 1977, a guard at a nuclear missile base was taken by aliens, then questioned and examined at the base hospital, where he was found with strange round marks. The man is Mario Woods, who guarded intercontinental nuclear missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. The researcher Robert Hastings, who interviewed him, tells Michels that at the hospital he had a round wound "with a little dimple in the center" on his forehead and his ankle. If true, his body would carry physical evidence of the event. Michels, telling it in another episode, stresses that Woods held a high security clearance called a Q clearance and says a doctor checked his teeth. Hastings's own article, "Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site", dated 10 September 2017, gives Woods's words differently. There, at the hospital, "two skin samples were taken, one from the back of my right hand and another above my right eyebrow, as I was sunburned for some strange reason." The two round dimpled marks are separate: "One is under my left armpit and the other is on my left foot, above the ankle," and Woods says he cannot remember when he got them.

discussion.by: Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site
discussion.text: In his own 2017 article Hastings gives Woods's account: at the base hospital "two skin samples were taken—one from the back of my right hand and another above my right eyebrow—as I was sunburned", while the two round marks "with a raised dimple in the center" are "under my left armpit" and "on my left foot, above the ankle", marks Woods cannot date. Hastings's later spoken telling puts dimpled wounds on the forehead and the ankle, found at the hospital; the 2017 text keeps the hospital's skin samples above the eyebrow and the dimpled marks at the armpit and ankle apart, and it dates the night to November 1977.
